method: Written by Claude (Anthropic's AI) reading Valve's complete patch diff, cross-referenced against live OpenDota win rates. Numbers, mechanics and arithmetic are checked. Anything about how the meta will respond is a prediction and is flagged as one. No pro or community consensus is claimed anywhere — there's no data source for it.
tldr: Nothing was reworked, but four systemic changes ripple across dozens of heroes. Each line looks tiny; together they change how you itemise and how you gank.

verdict.label: Systemic balance patch
verdict.shape: Almost all small numbers — the story is in the shared mechanics, not the hero list.
verdict.biggest_loser: Late-game carries — Satanic, Refresher Shard, Butterfly and Haunt all trimmed at once.
verdict.biggest_winner: Shadow Blade buyers — six heroes can now toggle without breaking invisibility.

beyond_gameplay.note: Shipped with 7.41e but absent from Valve's gameplay notes feed, so it isn't in the lists above. Found while cross-checking other coverage.

items.title: Soft ranked reset
items.what: Immortal matchmaking was recalculated, moving players into a 1–9,500 MMR band where some had previously sat as high as 17,000.
items.why: For anyone near the top this is the most consequential thing in the patch, and it has nothing to do with heroes.

items.title: Summer Scrub 2026
items.what: Roughly 200 bug fixes and quality-of-life changes shipped alongside the balance pass.
items.why: Individually small, but it's where several long-standing interaction bugs were finally fixed.

items.title: TI15 content
items.what: Predictions, Fantasy and Supporter Bundles for The International 15.
items.why: No gameplay effect — listed so the picture is complete.

people.name: Torte de Lini

people.status: His guides were published against 7.41d when this brief was written — no 7.41e rebuild yet. Worth a look to see if that's changed.

themes.title: Six heroes no longer break invisibility when toggling
themes.what: Troll's Battle Stance, Zeus's Lightning Hands, Elder Titan's Astral Spirit controls, Visage's Stone Form, Medusa's Split Shot and Muerta's Gunslinger no longer break invisibility. Zeus and Medusa can also toggle while silenced.
themes.why: You used to set your toggle *before* going invisible and hope you guessed the fight right. Now you walk in and configure on the way. Shadow Blade, Glimmer and Smoke all got better on the six heroes that found them most awkward.
do: Shadow Blade is a real item on Medusa, Muerta and Troll now — no tempo cost to set up mid-approach.
Stop pre-toggling Lightning Hands in smoke ganks. Flip it as the initiation lands.
Visage can order Familiars to execute from Stone Form without revealing himself.
themes.watch: If Shadow Blade starts appearing on Medusa and Muerta, this line is why.

Toggling on/off no longer breaks invisibility and can be done while silenced
Return and Move sub-abilities no longer break invisibility when used
No longer breaks invisibility when used to order Familiars to execute

themes.title: Kaya's mana regen drops from 30% to 20%
themes.what: Kaya 30% → 20%. Meteor Hammer 35% → 25%. Kaya and Sange 40% → 30%. Yasha and Kaya 40% → 30%. Urn of Shadows also dropped from +1.25 to +1 mana regen.
themes.why: This is *amplification*, so the bonus shrank by a third — not by ten percent. Every int core that treated a mid-game Kaya as the end of their mana problems no longer has one, and the Urn nerf removes the cheap substitute.
do: Hold your Bottle longer than usual.
Soul Ring and Arcane Boots get relatively better — raw mana wasn't touched.
Kaya's spell amp and intelligence are untouched. Just don't buy it *for* the regen.
themes.watch: Out of mana in fights you used to be fine in? This, not your play.

Mana Regen Amplification decreased from 35% to 25%
Mana Regen Amplification decreased from 40% to 30%

themes.title: Root now cancels channels and teleports
themes.what: Root now interrupts Twin Gate channeling, Underlord's Fiend's Gate and Templar Assassin's Psionic Projection. Sniper can now cast Concussive Grenade while rooted, without the knockback.
themes.why: Root has a distinct job now: stun stops everything, silence stops casting, root stops you *leaving*. Underlord is the casualty — Fiend's Gate is his identity and any root cancels it. Naga, Meepo, Treant and Broodmother all gained a use overnight.
do: As Underlord, channel from further back and check for roots before committing the team.
A root is now a real counter-pick against Underlord and heavy gate rotations.
Templar Assassin can't rely on Psionic Projection to escape a rooting lineup.
themes.watch: Expect roots to be valued a notch higher in draft.

changes.text: Channeling the Twin Gate can now be interrupted by root
Gate channeling can now be interrupted by root
Can now be interrupted by root
Can now be cast while rooted, but will not knock Sniper back if he is under the effect of root

agreement.note: Dota2ProTips: roots gain strategic value for punishing escapes and rotations.

themes.title: Four separate nerfs to late-game carries
themes.what: Satanic cooldown 30s → 40s. Refresher Shard lost all its stats. Butterfly traded 5 agility for 5 damage. Spectre's Haunt was flattened.
themes.why: No single line moves the needle; four together do. Satanic at 40s means one Unholy Rage per fight instead of two — exactly the scenario where an unkillable carry decided games. Butterfly's swap also costs agility carries armour and attack speed that +5 damage doesn't replace.
do: Treat Satanic as once per fight. Burning it to win a trade means not having it for the fight.
Butterfly is now better on non-agility heroes, worse on classic agility carries.
Refresher Shard is pure utility now — recheck whether it still earns the slot.
themes.watch: Long fights against a fed carry should be meaningfully more winnable.

changes.text: Unholy Rage cooldown increased from 30s to 40s
No longer provides +12 Health Regen, +6 Mana Regen, or +20 Damage
Agility bonus decreased from +35 to +30; Damage bonus increased from +25 to +30
Illusion Damage rescaled from 30/50/70% to 35/50/65%

agreement.note: Dota2ProTips calls the Satanic cooldown one of the biggest item nerfs in the patch.

themes.title: Legion's infinite Duel chain is dead
themes.what: Level 25 talent 'Duel Refreshes Cooldown On Victory' is now 'Duel Advances Cooldown by 30s On Victory'. Also: base strength 24 → 25, base attack speed 100 → 105, more level 1 damage, strength gain 3.1 → 3.0.
themes.why: A guaranteed follow-up duel became a maybe. Valve moved that power into her lane instead — +5 base attack speed and +1 strength is a real level 1 upgrade. Stronger early, much less terrifying at 25.
do: Play her harder early; the stats she gained are front-loaded.
Against a fed Legion, extended fights are survivable again.
themes.watch: 52.4% winrate on 14.7% of games. Expect fewer late-game blowouts, similar winrate.

changes.text: Level 25 Talent Duel Refreshes Cooldown On Victory replaced with Duel Advances Cooldown by 30s On Victory
Base Strength increased from 24 to 25
Base Attack Speed increased from 100 to 105
Strength gain decreased from 3.1 to 3.0

agreement.note: Nobody we read discussed the level 25 Duel talent. CyberScore reports her pick rate falling, but attributes it to the strength nerf.

themes.title: Drow's Multishot no longer scales with attack range
themes.what: Multishot arrow range changed from 1.75× attack range to 475 + 1× attack range. Mana cost 50 → 70 at rank 1, and base damage down 20 percentage points at every level.
themes.why: The range line looks neutral and isn't. At her base 625 range it's a wash (1094 → 1100), but at 755 with a Dragon Lance it's 1230 instead of 1321 — you lose range exactly when you pay for it. Add 40% more mana at level 1 and it's a much worse laning tool.
do: Buy Dragon Lance and Pike for the auto-attacks, not to extend Multishot.
Stop spamming it in lane. 70 mana at level 1 is a serious chunk of her pool.
themes.watch: This is arithmetic — both figures come straight from the two formulas.

changes.text: Arrow Range rescaled from 1.75x Drow Ranger's Attack Range to 475 + 1x Drow Ranger's Attack Range
Mana Cost increased from 50/70/90/110 to 70/85/100/115

agreement.note: Dota2ProTips and win.gg both call Multishot severely nerfed. CyberScore reports she has since lost over 5% win rate.

themes.title: Charge items no longer farm in your stash
themes.what: Urn of Shadows, Spirit Vessel and Essence Distiller no longer gain charges from nearby hero deaths while sitting in your stash.
themes.why: An Urn parked in your base was collecting charges off every death near your fountain — including fights you were losing. The item has to be carried to earn now.
do: Buy an early Urn, carry it. Stashing it to save the slot now costs you real value.
Slightly lowers the ceiling on late-game Vessel supports topping up during base defence.
themes.watch: Low visibility, but it removes a free lunch the informed were taking.

When in Stash, no longer grants charges from nearby hero deaths

themes.title: Clockwerk's Cogs lost vision and camp blocking
themes.what: Power Cogs vision cut from 1600/600 to 800/400, cogs no longer block creep camps, travel distance now scales 850-1000 instead of a flat 1000, mana burn down at higher levels.
themes.why: Cogs were a free 1600-vision ward you could drop anywhere, and a camp block. Both gone. Trapping is untouched, so this barely affects casual Clockwerk and guts the expert version.
do: Budget real wards for what cogs used to scout.
Level 1 travel distance dropped 1000 → 850 — practise the tighter spacing.
themes.watch: A nerf that mostly hits people who were playing the hero well.

themes.title: Invoker's Ghost Walk is 10 seconds shorter
bites: Shard no longer widens the radius
themes.what: Ghost Walk duration cut from 60s to 50s, and the Aghanim's Shard no longer increases its radius.
themes.why: 10 seconds less free map movement, and the Shard's radius bonus is gone so it's no longer a gank tool. He's in 19% of games, so most people will meet this.
do: Ganking him: slightly bigger window before he can walk away.
Playing him: don't buy the Shard for the Ghost Walk radius.
themes.watch: 51.9% winrate on 18.9% of games — the most-picked hero in this patch's list.

themes.title: Mask of Madness now favours melee
themes.what: Berserk movement speed on ranged heroes 8% → 6%. Slow resistance is now 15% ranged and 30% melee, where it used to be 30% for everyone.
themes.why: Slow resistance is what let a ranged carry pop Berserk and still get away. Halving it for ranged only makes that window far more punishing. Melee lost nothing.
do: Reassess MoM on ranged carries — still strong damage, much worse escape.
Your slows are now far more effective on a ranged hero who just popped Berserk.
themes.watch: Expect MoM to drift toward melee heroes.

changes.text: Berserk movement speed bonus on ranged heroes decreased from 8% to 6%
Berserk now provides 15% slow resistance for ranged heroes and 30% for melee heroes, instead of 30% for any hero

agreement.note: Dota2ProTips groups it under changes stacking up against ranged carries.

themes.title: Spectre's Haunt is weaker at max level
themes.what: Haunt illusion damage rescaled from 30/50/70% to 35/50/65%, and the level 25 talent dropped from +15% to +12%.
themes.why: Rank 1 got better, rank 3 and the level 25 talent got worse. She's the strongest carry in the data at 54.1%, and this takes power precisely from the late game where she was oppressive.
do: As Spectre, her spike is earlier — a 40-minute plan is weaker than it was.
Against her, max-level Haunt does about 7% less illusion damage before talents.
themes.watch: The clearest 'aimed at a strong hero' change in the patch.

changes.text: Illusion Damage rescaled from 30/50/70% to 35/50/65%
Level 25 Talent All Spectre Illusion Damage decreased from +15% to +12%

agreement.note: Dota2ProTips lists it as an honourable mention only.

themes.title: Bane's Nightmare now fully blinds you
themes.what: Nightmare now completely disables the target's sight instead of overriding their vision range, for 0.5s less duration at every level.
themes.why: Nightmare used to shrink your vision. Now you see nothing at all, so Bane's team can reposition or walk straight past you while you're blind. Half a second is a cheap price for that.
do: Getting Nightmared is disorienting now — assume you know nothing when it ends.
As Bane, you're trading duration for total information denial. Worth it.
themes.watch: His Ichor tweak also slightly lowers his status resistance ceiling.

changes.text: Now completely disables the target's sight, instead of overriding the vision range value
Duration decreased from 3.5/4.5/5.5/6.5s to 3/4/5/6s

agreement.note: Dota2ProTips lists Bane as a straight loser and doesn't mention the sight change at all. We read it as mixed because total blindness is a real gain. Treat this one as our opinion.

themes.title: Phantom Assassin's Blur can't be dispelled
themes.what: Blur can no longer be dispelled.
themes.why: Stripping Blur with a dispel was one of the cleaner answers to her evasion. That's gone, so you need real true strike — a much bigger investment.
do: Buy Monkey King Bar or Bloodthorn. Dispelling Blur is no longer an option.
themes.watch: She's at 49.8% winrate on 14.4% of games, so most players will meet this.

agreement.note: Nobody we read singled this out. It's our own reading.

themes.title: Double Divine Rapier spell amp no longer stacks
themes.what: Spell Amplification from multiple Divine Rapiers no longer stacks.
themes.why: Closes a cheese stack. The damage still adds up — only the spell amp was capped — so this changes nothing in a normal game.
do: Ignore this unless you were stacking Rapiers for spell damage.
themes.watch: Listed for completeness rather than impact.

agreement.note: Not mentioned in the coverage we read.

themes.title: Chaos Knight's stun is 30% faster
themes.what: Chaos Bolt travels at 900 instead of 700.
themes.why: Cuts your reaction time by about a third. A stun that good players answered with a quick blink or Eul's is now far more reliable.
do: React to the cast animation, not the projectile — you have much less time.
themes.watch: Raises his floor in ordinary games more than his ceiling in pro ones.

changes.text: Bolt Speed increased from 700 to 900

agreement.note: Not mentioned in the coverage we read.

bane.summary: Nightmare is now a true blind, at the cost of half a second.
bane.why: Before, Nightmare left you a small circle of vision. Now you see nothing at all, so Bane's team can walk straight past you or set up a fight while you're blind. The cost is half a second of duration.
play: Use Nightmare as setup — your team can reposition freely while the target is blind.
counter: Assume you know nothing about enemy positions when it ends.

rattletrap.summary: Cogs lost their two expert uses: free vision and camp blocking.
rattletrap.why: Good Clockwerks used cogs as a free ward — 1600 vision dropped anywhere — and to block enemy jungle camps. Both are gone. If you only ever used cogs to trap people, nothing changed for you.
play: Budget real wards for what cogs used to scout.
counter: Much less free vision around Roshan and high ground.

troll_warlord.summary: Battle Trance now grants 35% slow resistance, and stance toggling doesn't break invisibility.
troll_warlord.why: 35% slow resistance during Battle Trance means enemies can't kite you out of your own ultimate. With the toggle fix on top, Shadow Blade finally works properly on him.
play: Shadow Blade is a better pickup — pick your stance mid-approach.
counter: Slows are 35% weaker on him during Battle Trance.

legion_commander.summary: Better level 1, no more guaranteed second Duel.
legion_commander.why: Winning a duel used to fully reset it, so a fed Legion duelled again immediately. Now it only takes 30 seconds off, so a follow-up isn't guaranteed. She gets a stronger level 1 instead — about 22 more health and faster attacks.
play: Push your advantage earlier — the gains are front-loaded.
counter: Long fights against a fed Legion are survivable again.

snapfire.summary: Hit in five places at once — damage down across the kit plus three talent cuts.
snapfire.why: Every part of her kit does less damage and three talents were cut. Scatterblast's width also stopped growing with AoE bonuses, which kills a whole build.
play: Scatterblast needs tighter positioning now that width can't be inflated.
counter: Her burst is lower at every stage.

drow_ranger.summary: Multishot stopped scaling with attack range items.
drow_ranger.why: Multishot used to reach further every time you bought attack range. Now it barely does — with a Dragon Lance you actually lose about 90 range. It also costs 20 more mana at level 1, which is a lot when you're level 1.
play: Buy range items for the auto-attacks, not to extend Multishot.
counter: Her lane spam is far more mana-limited.

zuus.summary: Ultimate damage down, but Lightning Hands toggles while invisible or silenced.
zuus.why: His ultimate does 8-11% less damage, so fewer kills sniped from across the map. In exchange he can flip Lightning Hands on mid-gank instead of guessing before he goes in.
play: Toggle Lightning Hands as the gank lands, not before.
counter: His global finish is weaker — slightly more low-HP leeway.

doom_bringer.summary: Shorter attack range, and Infernal Blade shifted from early damage to late.
doom_bringer.why: 25 less attack range means standing closer to last hit, where he can be hit back. Infernal Blade got worse at low levels and better at max.
play: Skill Infernal Blade later — its early value dropped.
counter: Contest his last hits harder; he reaches 25 units less far.

gyrocopter.summary: A rescue attempt — mana costs down across the board.
gyrocopter.why: Homing Missile costs a flat 120 mana instead of scaling up to 150, and returns about 5 seconds sooner. You can throw it out to harass instead of saving it.
play: Homing Missile is far more spammable — use it as harassment.
counter: Expect more frequent missiles in lane.

obsidian_destroyer.summary: Objurgation is now instant-cast and doesn't stop your movement.
obsidian_destroyer.why: The barrier used to stop you moving while you cast it. It's instant now, so you can shield yourself mid-chase or mid-escape without losing a step.
play: Barrier while running — it costs you nothing now.
counter: He can shield reactively, so burst windows are tighter.

treant.summary: Slower attacks, shorter early root, pricier early Living Armor.
treant.why: 10 less base attack speed makes last hitting noticeably harder. Living Armor also costs 80 mana at rank 1 instead of 65 — a lot for a support with no items yet.
play: Be more selective with early Living Armor.
counter: His level 1-2 root is noticeably shorter.

hoodwink.summary: Sharpshooter costs a lot more mana and Boomerang is on a longer leash.
hoodwink.why: Sharpshooter costs 50 more mana at every rank, so you can't fire it off casually to scout or chip. Boomerang comes back 2 seconds slower.
play: You can't casually cast Sharpshooter to scout or chip anymore.
counter: Her harassment is meaningfully slower.

axe.summary: Less armour and attack speed, weaker Battle Hunger scaling.
axe.why: 2 less base agility is about 0.33 armour and 2 attack speed. Small, but it's on the hero whose whole plan is being hit. Battle Hunger also does 20% less damage at max.
play: Battle Hunger is a weaker maxing choice.
counter: Marginally easier to trade with in lane.

morphling.summary: Morph is available more often and the scepter illusion can see.
morphling.why: Morph returns 10-15 seconds sooner, so he can swap between tanky and damage far more often. The scepter illusion can also see properly now, making it useful for scouting.
play: The scepter illusion is a map tool now, not just a body.
counter: He swaps stats more often — burst windows close faster.

nevermore.summary: Smaller mana pool and the level 25 raze talent no longer procs attack modifiers.
nevermore.why: 2 less base intelligence is 24 less mana, exactly when he wants to spam razes. The level 25 talent also stopped triggering item effects, which was the main reason to take it.
play: The raze stack window is a second tighter — sequence faster.
counter: His level 25 talent no longer carries item procs.

necrolyte.summary: Death Seeker lost 150 cast range, and Sadist scales worse.
necrolyte.why: Death Seeker's range drops from 750 to 600, so he has to walk 150 units closer before he can start anything. That's a real window to punish him.
play: You're inside a much tighter range to land Death Seeker.
counter: He has to step 150 units closer — that's your punish window.

queenofpain.summary: Cheaper Shadow Strike, and double Sonic Waves now stack.
queenofpain.why: Cheaper Shadow Strike softens the Kaya mana nerf. Two ultimates cast back to back now both deal full damage, which only matters if you buy Refresher.
play: Refresher combos got better — the second wave isn't wasted.
counter: A Refresher QoP now does full double-ultimate damage.

death_prophet.why: More agility and damage every level. By level 25 that's roughly 1.25 extra armour and 7 attack speed — small each level, real by the end.
play: Her right-click contribution grows faster now.

pugna.summary: Slightly more intelligence and damage at level 1.
pugna.why: One more base intelligence is 12 more mana and a point of damage. You won't feel it.
play: Very slightly better level 1 last hitting.

invoker.summary: Ghost Walk is 10 seconds shorter and the Shard no longer widens it.
invoker.why: 10 seconds less invisibility is 10 seconds less free movement around the map, and the Shard no longer widens Ghost Walk's slow. He's a little easier to catch out.
play: Don't buy the Shard for the Ghost Walk radius.
counter: Slightly larger window to catch him out of position.

undying.summary: Slower walking around, same speed inside his ultimate.
undying.why: 5 slower walking around, 5 faster inside Flesh Golem. Net: same in a fight, slower everywhere else, which nudges you to ult to engage rather than walk in.
play: You're 5 speed slower all game except when ulting.

keeper_of_the_light.summary: Chakra Magic on a longer cooldown, Solar Bind 100 range shorter.
keeper_of_the_light.why: One second longer on Chakra means less mana handed to your carry, on top of the Kaya nerfs. Solar Bind also reaches 100 less, so he has to commit closer.
play: Solar Bind takes real commitment at 750 range.
counter: His mana battery role is less generous.

centaur.summary: Retaliate returns less damage; Shard buff is shorter.
centaur.why: Retaliate returns about 12% less damage. That bites hardest in long fights, which is exactly how Centaur wins them.
play: Standing in a fight returns less — commit more deliberately.

elder_titan.summary: More armour from Momentum, and Astral Spirit controls don't break invisibility.
elder_titan.why: Momentum turns movement speed into armour at a better rate — the base went from 5% to 7%, a 40% improvement. Movement speed items are worth more on him now.
play: Movement speed items are worth more — they convert to armour better.

oracle.summary: False Promise reaches further, but Fate's Edict can now be stripped.
oracle.why: Enemies can now dispel Fate's Edict off you or an ally, so the save can simply be removed. False Promise reaches 100 further at rank 1 to make up for it.
play: Against dispel-heavy lineups, Fate's Edict isn't a reliable save.
counter: Bring a dispel and strip the Edict off his carry.

spirit_bear.summary: Lone Druid's bear takes towers a third slower and has less armour.
spirit_bear.why: Demolish drops from 30% to 20% bonus damage to buildings, so the bear takes towers roughly a third slower. Fast towers are the entire reason Lone Druid gets picked.
play: Recalculate what you can take before a rotation arrives.
counter: You have more time to answer a Lone Druid push.

lone_druid.summary: Savage Roar talents cut alongside the bear's push nerf.
lone_druid.why: Savage Roar returns 1 second slower and covers 25 less radius. Minor alone, but they land in the same patch as the bear's tower nerf.
play: Push speed and defensive Roar got worse together.

phantom_lancer.summary: Juxtapose Shard on a 3-second longer cooldown.
phantom_lancer.why: The shard illusion returns 3 seconds slower, so slightly fewer illusions across a fight. A light touch for a hero winning 53% of his games.
counter: Longer gaps between his shard illusion bursts.

puck.summary: Illusory Orb costs a second more cooldown at every level.
puck.why: One second longer on Illusory Orb at every level. Across a lane that's one less orb for harass or escape.
play: One less orb over a long lane exchange.

tiny.summary: One less health regen, on a hero already struggling.
tiny.why: 1 less health regen makes staying in lane harder. Worth noting because he's already one of the weakest heroes in the patch at 44.7%.
play: Budget more regen consumables.

vengefulspirit.summary: The scepter illusion can see properly now.
vengefulspirit.why: The scepter illusion can see properly now, so you can send it to hold vision or push a side lane instead of only using it for damage.
play: Use the illusion to hold vision or push a side lane.

lina.summary: Two points of base agility gone.
lina.why: 2 less base agility — about 0.33 armour and 2 attack speed. Slightly harder last hitting early, nothing after that.
play: Marginally harder early last hitting.

witch_doctor.summary: The Maledict talent no longer bursts off illusions.
witch_doctor.why: A fix so the level 20 talent stops bursting off illusions. Nothing changes unless you were relying on that.
play: No change unless you were exploiting it.

sniper.summary: Concussive Grenade is castable while rooted.
sniper.why: He can now use the grenade while rooted. He doesn't get the self-push, but he can still shove someone off him — an escape he simply didn't have before.
play: Root no longer locks you out of the grenade.

venomancer.summary: Snakebite initial damage up sharply at higher levels.
venomancer.why: Snakebite does 30% more damage at max rank and gives up nothing. It's worth maxing now.
play: Maxing Snakebite is a stronger choice than it was.

phantom_assassin.summary: Blur can no longer be dispelled.
phantom_assassin.why: Dispelling Blur used to strip her evasion. It doesn't anymore, so you need Monkey King Bar or Bloodthorn — a far bigger purchase than a dispel.
counter: Buy true strike. Dispelling Blur is no longer an option.

templar_assassin.summary: Psionic Projection can now be interrupted by root.
templar_assassin.why: Any root now cancels her escape. Bad news for a hero already sitting at 46.5%.
counter: A root cancels her projection escape outright.

dragon_knight.summary: Wyrm's Wrath splash area up 20% at every level.
dragon_knight.why: 20% more splash in dragon form, so waves die faster and pushes come sooner.
play: Faster wave clear means better push windows.

omniknight.summary: Hammer of Purity heals more, faster.
omniknight.why: The heal delivers more in less time — 40% over 4 seconds instead of 35% over 5. Speed is what matters when burst is killing the person you're saving.
play: The heal now lands fast enough to contest burst.

night_stalker.why: 25 less radius on Crippling Fear. A small trim on a hero winning 53% of his games.
play: Tighter positioning needed to catch multiple heroes.

weaver.summary: The thread stretches further as you level.
weaver.why: The thread now stretches further the more you level, reaching 1140 by level 25 instead of a flat 900.
play: The thread holds over longer distances as the game goes.

jakiro.summary: Intelligence gain up, which is mana and damage.
jakiro.why: More intelligence per level — roughly 90 extra mana by level 25. Welcome on a support who is always empty.
play: A little more room to cast in the mid game.

batrider.summary: Smoldering Resin no longer applies when attacking allies.
batrider.why: A fix so he stops putting his own debuff on friendly units when denying. Normal play is unaffected.
play: Denying no longer wastes resin.

spectre.summary: Her late-game Haunt is weaker; early Haunt slightly stronger.
spectre.why: Haunt sends illusions that copy a share of her damage. That share moved from 30/50/70% to 35/50/65%, so an early Haunt hits slightly harder and a max-level Haunt hits noticeably less. She's the best carry in the game at 54.1%, and this takes power from the late game where she was winning.
play: Her spike is earlier — a 40-minute plan is weaker now.
counter: Late Haunt does ~7% less illusion damage before talents.

ancient_apparition.summary: Ice Blast cooldown cut by 10 seconds at rank 1.
ancient_apparition.why: Ice Blast returns 10 seconds sooner at rank 1 — often the difference between having it for a fight and not.
play: You can use Ice Blast more speculatively early.

chaos_knight.summary: Chaos Bolt is 30% faster and much harder to dodge.
chaos_knight.why: His stun flies 30% faster, so you have about a third less time to blink or Eul's out of it. Far more reliable.
counter: React to the cast animation, not the projectile.

visage.summary: Stone Form no longer breaks invisibility when ordering Familiars.
visage.why: He can order Familiars to attack from Stone Form without breaking invisibility, so invisible setups actually work. He's also the highest-winrate hero in this patch at 54.5%.
play: Invisibility-based Familiar setups are viable now.

medusa.summary: Split Shot toggles while invisible or silenced.
medusa.why: You no longer decide Split Shot on or off before going invisible, and a silence can't lock you into the wrong one. Shadow Blade is a genuine option now.
play: Shadow Blade is a real option — configure on the approach.

magnataur.why: 25 more damage on Horn Toss. Nothing else moves.
play: Marginally more damage on the setup.

ember_spirit.why: 5 slower base movement, permanently, on a hero whose entire game is moving.
play: Slightly worse at chasing and repositioning on foot.

earth_spirit.why: 1 less base intelligence is 12 less mana, on a hero who is always short of it. The level 20 Magnetize talent was trimmed too.
play: Mana is a little tighter in early rotations.

abyssal_underlord.summary: Fiend's Gate can now be cancelled by any root in the game.
abyssal_underlord.why: Any root in the game now cancels his global teleport. That's how his team commits and retreats, so you have to check the enemy draft before planning around it.
play: Channel from further back; check for roots before committing.
counter: One root cancels his global. Draft accordingly.

grimstroke.summary: Dark Portrait illusion can see properly.
grimstroke.why: The Dark Portrait copy can see properly now, so it works for vision and split-pushing rather than only damage.
play: The illusion is a map tool as well as damage now.

mars.why: More intelligence per level — roughly 60 extra mana by level 25. Small, but he's at 46.7% so anything helps.
play: A little more casting room mid game.

ringmaster.summary: Impalement Arts clears creeps much worse early, slightly better late.
ringmaster.why: Impalement Arts kills creeps 30% slower at rank 1 and doesn't catch up until rank 4. Slower farming exactly when farming matters most.
play: Slower early wave clear and jungle farming.

muerta.why: Same fix as Medusa and Troll — you can flip Gunslinger while invisible, so Shadow Blade setups actually work.
play: Shadow Blade is a more comfortable item now.

beastmaster.why: Both late talents were trimmed, and Primal Roar returns 5 seconds slower with the level 25. An odd call on a hero already at 46.7%.
play: Primal Roar returns 5 seconds slower with the level 25 talent.

butterfly.summary: Worse on agility carries, better on everyone else.
butterfly.why: You trade 5 agility for 5 damage. On an agility carry those 5 agility were also 0.83 armour and 5 attack speed, so you come out behind. On a strength or intelligence hero the agility was worth less, so it's a small gain.
butterfly.who: Agility carries lose; strength and int heroes buying it for evasion gain slightly.

mask_of_madness.summary: Ranged heroes lost half their slow resistance; melee kept all of it.
mask_of_madness.why: Slow resistance is what let a ranged carry switch it on and still get away. Cutting it to 15% for ranged only means the window where you take extra damage is now genuinely dangerous. Melee heroes lost nothing.
mask_of_madness.who: Clinkz, Sniper, Gyrocopter and ranged-stance Troll.

kaya.summary: The regen bonus itself shrank by a third.
kaya.why: This multiplies your existing regen rather than adding a flat amount, so going 30% to 20% removes a third of what Kaya was giving you. Spell amp and intelligence are untouched — still a good damage item, just no longer the fix for running out of mana.
kaya.who: Every int core that treated Kaya as the end of their mana problems.

kaya_and_sange.summary: Same regen cut as the rest of the line.
kaya_and_sange.why: A quarter off the mana regen. Status resistance and spell amp are unchanged, so it's still worth buying — just don't count on the sustain.
kaya_and_sange.who: Hybrid cores like Doom, Legion Commander and Dragon Knight.

yasha_and_kaya.summary: Same regen cut as the rest of the line.
yasha_and_kaya.why: A quarter off the mana regen. Movement speed, attack speed and spell amp all survive intact.
yasha_and_kaya.who: Storm Spirit, Ember Spirit and similar mobile spell-spammers.

meteor_hammer.summary: The biggest mana regen cut of the four.
meteor_hammer.why: The biggest cut in the line — 29% off the regen. Supports often buy this as much for the mana as the stun, and that half got clearly worse.
meteor_hammer.who: Supports who bought it partly for sustain.

satanic.summary: One Unholy Rage per fight instead of two.
satanic.why: In a long fight you used to get two Unholy Rages. Now you get one. That's precisely the situation where an unkillable carry used to win the game on their own.
satanic.who: Every right-click carry, lifestealing melee most of all.

refresher_shard.summary: Stripped of all its stats — it only does the thing now.
refresher_shard.why: It used to be a decent stat stick that also refreshed your spells. Now it's only the refresh — so if you were slotting it early for the regen and damage, that reason is gone.
refresher_shard.who: Anyone who slotted it early for the stats.

rapier.summary: Double Rapier spell amp no longer stacks.
rapier.why: Only the spell amp was capped; the damage still stacks. Changes nothing in a normal game.

urn_of_shadows.summary: Less mana regen, and no more free charges from the stash.
urn_of_shadows.why: Two cuts. Less mana regen, and an Urn left in your base used to collect charges from deaths near your fountain — including fights you were losing. Now you have to carry it to earn them.
urn_of_shadows.who: Supports who bought it early and stashed it.

spirit_vessel.why: Same fix as Urn. No more free charges while it sits in your base during a defence.
spirit_vessel.who: Late-game supports holding Vessel through base defences.

essence_distiller.why: Same fix again. All three charge items got it in one patch, which is what makes it deliberate rather than incidental.
essence_distiller.who: Anyone stashing it for passive charges.

skadi.summary: Cold Attack attack speed slow up by a quarter.
skadi.why: 25% attack speed slow instead of 20%. It was already the answer to a fed right-clicker, and it's better at that job now.
skadi.who: Anyone building it to shut down an enemy carry.

hand_of_midas.why: 5 more attack speed makes it less awkward to hold onto after you've spent the charges.

abyssal_blade.why: 4 more strength is about 88 extra health, free, on an item you were already buying. You're simply harder to kill.

heavens_halberd.summary: One second off the disarm cooldown.
heavens_halberd.why: One second less on the disarm, so you can shut down an attacking carry slightly more often.

shivas_guard.summary: Cheaper recipe, same total cost — easier to build toward.
shivas_guard.why: Same total cost, but 100 gold moved out of the recipe into the components. More of your gold is doing something for you while you build it.
shivas_guard.who: Anyone building Shiva's — same item, friendlier path.

gungir.summary: Cheaper recipe, same total cost — easier to build toward.
gungir.why: Same idea — 100 gold shifted from the recipe into usable parts. The finished item is identical.

veil_of_discord.summary: Spell Weakness costs half the mana.
veil_of_discord.why: Half the mana to cast. Supports buy Veil, and supports are the ones feeling the Kaya nerfs, so this pushes back a little.
veil_of_discord.who: Magic damage lineups and their supports.

orb_of_venom.why: 20% more damage per second, at the stage of the game when health pools are small enough for that to actually hurt.

orb_of_corrosion.why: Cuts enemy healing a bit harder, which is the only reason anyone buys it.

orb_of_frost.summary: More healing reduction, and it stops misfiring on allies.
orb_of_frost.why: Cuts healing harder, and it stopped applying to your own units when you deny. Both changes favour whoever's holding it.

hurricane_pike.summary: One second off the Hurricane Thrust buff.
hurricane_pike.why: The attack range bonus after using the active lasts one second less.

crellas_crozier.summary: Longer speed steal, stronger aura effect.
crellas_crozier.why: Longer speed steal and a stronger aura, with nothing given up.

chasm_stone.why: 100 gold more expensive for exactly the same item, so it comes online a little later.

smoke_of_deceit.summary: Smoke can't be made to last longer.
smoke_of_deceit.why: Effects that stretch buff durations no longer stretch smoke. Only matters if you were stacking buff duration on purpose.
smoke_of_deceit.who: Anyone who was stacking buff-duration effects.

foragers_kit.why: Forages 25% faster. You use it constantly, so it adds up over a game.

conjurers_catalyst.summary: Weaker against non-heroes, and the illusion interaction was tightened.
conjurers_catalyst.why: A third less damage to creeps, so it farms worse. The illusion trigger was tightened too.

enchanters_bauble.why: A small trim to the only thing it does.

enhancement_greedy.why: 10-13% less gold per minute, which is the entire reason anyone picks it.

enhancement_feverish.summary: The drawback changed shape — much worse for casters.
enhancement_feverish.why: The downside changed completely. It used to make spells cost 7% more; now it cuts your maximum mana by 20%. For a caster who needs a full combo that's far worse. For a hero who barely casts, it's mild.

heavy_blade.why: Witchbane cleanses every 30 seconds instead of 40, so you get a dispel more often in fights with repeated debuffs.
